id.description: Stable identifier for the tab. Generated client-side; safe to omit on create.

pathname.description: URL pathname the tab points at — for example `/project/123/dashboard/45` or `/project/123/insights`. Combined with `search` and `hash` to reconstruct the destination.

search.description: Query string portion of the URL, including the leading `?`. Empty string when there is no query.

hash.description: Fragment portion of the URL, including the leading `#`. Empty string when there is no fragment.

title.description: Default tab title derived from the destination scene. Used when `customTitle` is not set.

customTitle.description: Optional user-provided title that overrides `title` in the navigation UI.

iconType.description: Icon key shown next to the tab in the sidebar — for example `dashboard`, `insight`, `blank`.

sceneId.description: Scene identifier resolved from the pathname when known — used by the frontend for icon/title hints.

sceneKey.description: Scene key (logic key) for the destination, paired with `sceneParams` for deeper routing context.

sceneParams.description: Free-form scene parameters captured at pin time, used by the frontend to rehydrate the destination.

pinned.description: Whether this entry is pinned. Always coerced to true on save — pass true or omit.
